classification.difficultyReason: Draw and name the central angle for a chord and an arc. This is the same recognition skill as p9-q4.

content.prompt:
$O$ is the centre of the circle.
Draw and name the angle subtended at the centre by each of these.

answer.worked: Join $O$ to $S$ and $T$. The angle between radii $OS$ and $OT$ is $\angle SOT$.
Join $O$ to $U$ and $V$. The angle between radii $OU$ and $OV$ is $\angle UOV$.
